notes_for_editor: Two pages describe this site and agree on the 1933 build, the 1950 abandonment and the 6,285 ft elevation. The FFLA Idaho list agrees on tower and gone, and gives coordinates that the record already has. Two WebSearches and the 2016 Clearwater NF lookout list (fs.usda.gov/media/259185) did not name Dent Point, so there is no independent history. The Green Ridge patrol-lookout line is ambiguous and the story says so. Neither page has a staff history, so staffing is left out. Record agency and design were null and are filled from the pages. Elevation is sourced (6,285 ft, about 1,916 m) but has no facts key; the editor may set elevation_m.
